test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some birds are animals.

All animals are tables.

Conclusions:

(I): Some birds are tables.

(II): All tables are animals.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some birds are animals.

All animals are tables.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6877f34648892237d0121fe228533d2055ec8eb25f7ef4cadc980a62356b7a84.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37917997e4a69fadc2e1bff0712df340f614e4eeff4dbbf05cc88a41cce6cfaa.png] 

Conclusions:

**(I): Some birds are tables**.

This follows directly from the combination of the two statements.

The portion of Birds that are Animals must also be Tables. 

Therefore, Conclusion (I) logically follows.

**(II): All tables are animals. **

Statement 2 ("All animals are tables") is an 'All A are B' statement. 

This does not allow us to reverse the relationship to 'All B are A' (i.e., all tables are animals). 

There could be tables that are not animals. 

Therefore, Conclusion (II) does not follow.

So, **Only conclusion (I) follows. **

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
